questions.explanation:
## Why This Is Asked
Tests understanding of secure, auditable deployments and basic rollback mechanics in CodePipeline.

## Key Concepts
- Least-privilege IAM for Lambda execution role and CodePipeline
- API Gateway permissions and resource policies
- CloudWatch alarms and automatic rollback in CI/CD
- Versioning and rollback of Lambda functions

## Code Example
```yaml
Resources:
  LambdaRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal: { Service: "lambda.amazonaws.com" }
            Action: "sts:AssumeRole"
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: LambdaLoggingPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: "arn:aws:logs:*:*:*"
        - PolicyName: S3AccessPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: s3:GetObject
                Resource: "arn:aws:s3:::deployment-bucket/*"

  LambdaFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaRole.Arn
      # ... other function properties

  ErrorAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: LambdaErrorAlarm
      AlarmDescription: "Triggers rollback on 5xx errors"
      MetricName: 5XXError
      Namespace: AWS/ApiGateway
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 5
      Threshold: 10
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref RollbackAction

  RollbackAction:
    Type: AWS::CodePipeline::Action
    Properties:
      Configuration:
        ActionTypeId:
          Category: Invoke
          Owner: AWS
          Provider: Lambda
          Version: 1
      InputArtifacts: []
      Name: RollbackAction
      RunOrder: 2
```

## Testing Steps
1. Deploy the CloudFormation stack
2. Verify Lambda has only minimal IAM permissions
3. Test API Gateway access controls
4. Trigger 5xx errors to confirm CloudWatch alarm activation
5. Verify automatic rollback to previous Lambda version

questions.explanation:
## Why This Is Asked
This question tests knowledge of multi-region CI/CD architecture, policy-based gates, security scanning integration, and operational readiness in an enterprise cloud environment.

## Key Concepts
- Cross-region GitHub Actions orchestration with AWS CDK provisioning
- SBOM/SCA/CVE scanning (Syft, Trivy, or similar tools) integrated into CI pipelines
- Policy gates enforced via OPA Gatekeeper and IAM Roles Anywhere for secure credential handling
- Per-branch canary deployments with weighted traffic routing
- OpenTelemetry-based SLI validation and automated rollback triggers
- Disaster recovery runbook and failover procedures

## Code Example
```yaml
name: Multi-Region Canary Deploy
on:
  push:
    branches: ['**']

env:
  AWS_REGION_PRIMARY: us-east-1
  AWS_REGION_SECONDARY: eu-central-1

jobs:
  build-and-scan:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    outputs:
      sbom-passed: ${{ steps.scan.outputs.sbom-passed }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      
      - name: Build application
        run: npm ci && npm run build
      
      - name: Generate SBOM
        run: |
          syft . -o cyclonedx-json > sbom.json
      
      - name: Run Trivy vulnerability scan
        id: scan
        run: |
          trivy fs --severity HIGH,CRITICAL .
          trivy image --severity HIGH,CRITICAL myapp:${{ github.sha }}
          echo "sbom-passed=true" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
      
      - name: Upload artifacts
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: build-artifacts
          path: |
            sbom.json
            dist/

  gate-policy:
    needs: build-and-scan
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      
      - name: OPA Gatekeeper policy evaluation
        run: |
          conftest test --policy policies/ deploy.yaml
      
      - name: Assume IAM Roles Anywhere role
        uses: aws-actions/configure-aws-credentials@v4
        with:
          role-to-assume: ${{ secrets.IAM_ROLE_ANYWHERE_ARN }}
          aws-region: ${{ env.AWS_REGION_PRIMARY }}

  deploy-canary:
    needs: [build-and-scan, gate-policy]
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      
      - name: Setup CDK
        run: npm install -g aws-cdk && npm ci
      
      - name: Deploy to Primary (us-east-1)
        run: |
          cdk deploy "*" --region us-east-1 \
            -c branch=${{ github.ref_name }} \
            -c canaryWeight=10
      
      - name: Deploy to Secondary (eu-central-1)
        run: |
          cdk deploy "*" --region eu-central-1 \
            -c branch=${{ github.ref_name }} \
            -c canaryWeight=10

  validate-sli:
    needs: deploy-canary
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Query OpenTelemetry metrics
        run: |
          curl -s ${{ secrets.OTEL_COLLECTOR }}/api/v1/query \
            -d 'query=histogram_quantile(0.99, rate(http_request_duration_seconds_bucket[5m]))'
      
      - name: Check rollback criteria
        run: |
          if [ "$LATENCY_P99" -gt 500 ]; then
            echo "Rolling back due to high latency"
            exit 1
          fi

  rollback:
    needs: validate-sli
    if: failure()
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Rollback deployment
        run: |
          cdk destroy "*" --region us-east-1
          cdk destroy "*" --region eu-central-1
```

## DR Runbook
1. **Detection**: Monitor OpenTelemetry dashboards for SLI violations exceeding thresholds
2. **Isolation**: Identify failing region via health checks and metrics
3. **Failover**: Update Route53 weighted records to redirect 100% traffic to healthy region
4. **Recovery**: Redeploy to failed region once issue is resolved
5. **Verification**: Validate SLIs return to normal before restoring traffic weight

## Why This Is Asked

- AWS Budgets and forecast alerts
- CloudWatch Events / Alarms
- Lambda integration with CodePipeline

- Testing rollback and guard behavior

## Code Example
```yaml
Resources:
  MonthlyBudget:
    Type: AWS::Budgets::Budget
    Properties:
      Budget:
        BudgetType: MONETARY
        TimeUnit: MONTHLY
        BudgetLimit:
          Amount: 100
          Unit: USD
      NotificationsWithSubscribers:
        - Notification:
            NotificationType: FORECASTED
            ComparisonOperator: GREATER_THAN
            Threshold: 80
            ThresholdType: FORECAST
          Subscribers:
            - SubscriptionType: EMAIL
              Address: ops@example.com
```

```yaml
# Account B: ECR Repository Policy (allows Account A to pull)
Resources:
  ⦁ RepoPolicy:
    Type: AWS::ECR::RepositoryPolicy
    Properties:
      RepositoryName: my-repo
      PolicyText:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: arn:aws:iam::ACCOUNT_A_ID:role/CodePipelineCrossAccountPull
            Action:
              - ecr:BatchCheckLayerAvailability
              - ecr:GetDownloadUrlForLayer
              - ecr:BatchGetImage
              - ecr:GetAuthorizationToken

```

```yaml
# Account A: CodePipeline cross-account pull role
Resources:
  CodePipelineCrossAccountPullRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: codepipeline.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: CrossAccountECRPull
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ecr:BatchCheckLayerAvailability
                  - ecr:GetDownloadUrlForLayer
                  - ecr:GetAuthorizationToken
                  - ecr:BatchGetImage
                Resource: arn:aws:ecr:us-east-1:ACCOUNT_B_ID:repository/my-repo
```

```yaml
Resources:

    Properties:

        - PolicyName: ECRCrossAccountPull
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
```
